children: RNS Number : 6157U  UBS ETFs  15 September 2026
IMPORTANT: This letter is important and requires your immediate attention. If you have any questions about the content of this letter, you should seek independent professional financial advice.
15 September 2026
Re:        UBS (Irl) ETF plc (the "Company")
UBS MSCI Pacific ex Japan IMI Socially Responsible UCITS ETF & UBS S&P 500 Climate Transition ESG UCITS ETF (each a "Fund" and together the "Funds")
Capitalised terms not otherwise defined in this letter have the meaning given to them in the prospectus of the Company and the supplements of the Funds, each dated 17 July 2026 (the "Prospectus").
Dear Shareholder

We are writing to you as a shareholder of a Fund to notify you of the decision of the board of Directors of the Company (the "Board"), to close the Funds with effect from 30 October 2026 (the "Termination Date"), in accordance with the powers provided to the Board in the Articles. The rationale for the closure of the Funds is that, due to profitability and scalability concerns, the Funds can no longer be managed in a commercially viable way.
Prior to the Termination Date, Shareholders on the primary market will be able to redeem their Shares in the normal manner and as is further described in the Prospectus:
(i)            in the case of UBS MSCI Pacific ex Japan IMI Socially Responsible UCITS ETF, from the publication of this notice to Shareholders up until 4.30pm (Dublin time) on 22 October 2026; and
(ii)           in the case of UBS S&P 500 Climate Transition ESG UCITS ETF, from the publication of this notice to Shareholders up until 4.30pm (Dublin time) on 23 October 2026.

Shareholders should note that the last day for trading the Shares on the relevant stock exchanges will be 16 October 2026 and trading will be suspended on the morning of 19 October 2026. Further information on such suspension will be published by the relevant stock exchanges.

Shareholders should note that on the Termination Date, the Company will automatically compulsorily repurchase any remaining Shares in the Funds. The net proceeds will then be distributed amongst the Shareholders in accordance with their respective shareholdings.

For Shareholders on the primary market, the Directors will endeavour to settle your repurchase proceeds as soon as possible thereafter and, in any event, no later than 6 November 2026. For Shareholders on the secondary market, the time(s) at which any such redemption proceeds are received will depend, among others, on the timeframes and arrangements in place at the respective custodian, broker and/or the relevant settlement system involved for processing of such payments, which in individual cases may take up to a few weeks.
Expenses relating to the termination of the Funds will be borne by the Funds.
If you have any queries in respect of the above, please do not hesitate to contact your usual UBS contact person.
Yours sincerely,
Director
for and on behalf of
UBS (Irl) ETF plc
